title: Nucleic Acid Purification with Magnetic Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Place labware on deck
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the Opentrons deck in the indicated slots: Opentrons 96‑Well Aluminum Block with Generic PCR Strip (200 µL slot), two Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Racks (200 µL slots), YDP 96‑Well Square Well‑Plate (2200 µL, magnetic module slot), and NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL). For the reservoir, use the customizations field to specify the distance from the side of the well for pipette aspiration as described in the protocol.

substeps.instruction: Load the Opentrons 96‑Well Aluminum Block with Generic PCR Strip into its 200 µL slot.
Load the first Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack (200 µL) into its designated slot.
Load the second Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack (200 µL) into its designated slot.
Load the YDP 96‑Well Square Well‑Plate (2200 µL) onto the magnetic module slot.
Load the NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL) onto its slot and set the aspiration distance from the well wall.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: Upload the custom labware definition files for the reservoir and plate into the Opentrons App (see the referenced article for help).

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package that contains the custom labware definitions for the reservoir and plate.

steps.title: Configure deck map
steps.instruction: Set up your deck according to the provided deck map, ensuring each piece of labware is positioned in its designated slot.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the Opentrons App, following the calibration guidance in the support articles.
